claims.claim: L2-03 retains typed versioned requests, exact source/target/proof pins, bounded closed schemas and canonical serialization.
Reuse independently refreshes native applicability and reviewed mapping authority, checks immutable TASK/base/scope bindings, and rechecks currentness after its additional reads.

Eligibility requires authenticated VALID applicability and complete stable original PASS with exact passing phase population, retained raw identity and reviewed semantic coverage. Exit zero or a waiver alone cannot establish satisfaction.

Original UNKNOWN now takes precedence over changed target conditions and remains BLOCKED. Authenticated relevant changes retain bounded affected dimensions/proof/obligation observations; malformed or unauthenticated target conditions remain blocked without execution permission.

REPAIR and REMEDIATION retain the conservative native-currentness boundary: unsupported correction lineage returns NOT_ESTABLISHED/BLOCKED, and caller predecessor, action, authorization, finding or verification pins cannot grant eligibility.

Real-Git conformance fixtures now rename all target phases consistently for authenticated population/collection changes. Separate adversarial cases preserve rejection of split phase records. Seven focused local cases passed with exit code 0.

The explicit read-only API and L3 consumer gates remain intact. The clean repair commit directly descends from the failed candidate and changes only three authorized paths; prior L2 observers, lifecycle authority, roadmap and policy activation surfaces remain unchanged.
